new.analysis:
The athlete has already dropped volume sharply this week; the next week should stay light and keep a single quality session early. A 4‑mile easy run on Tuesday, a 4‑mile threshold/tempo block of 4×800 m at marathon pace on Wednesday, a very short 3‑mile easy run Thursday, full rest Friday, a 8‑mile easy long run Saturday and race Sunday keeps legs fresh and preserves recovery while giving a brief race‑pace rehearsal.

The athlete asked whether adding a 16‑mile workout on Wednesday was too much; the data from this week shows a reduced total volume and heart‑rate zones largely in 2. The extra distance would push the body too hard and risk over‑recovery.

We’ll monitor heart‑rate drift on the quality session, ensure the Saturday run stays under 155 bpm, confirm sleep and hydration remain good, watch for any onset of soreness, and keep the race‑day prep routine consistent.

No safety concerns noted.
